title: Threadress - Co-Founder
text: Threadress (threadress.it.com), New York, NY - Co-Founder, March 2025-Present. Built an innovative platform connecting real-time boutique inventory to shoppers with reserve and prepay pickup options - seamlessly bridging online search and in-store retail experiences. Launched a functional prototype featuring real-time boutique inventory search, natural-language queries, and advanced vector search capabilities. Led comprehensive customer discovery with 50+ NYC boutiques, uncovering system preferences (Square vs Shopify) to guide strategic integration planning. Threadress emerged from personal struggle to find specific items, spending hours searching only to discover nothing similar. Despite recent developments, search engines like Google still prioritize sponsored brands over genuinely tailored fashion recommendations based on user intent. With the emergence of powerful AI tools, successfully built the first MVP and are now focused on scaling impact.
